description: Source registry; catalog entries do not constitute ingestion or current verification.

sources.name: US Treasury · OFAC SDN
sources.notes: SDN list is distinct from OFAC's non-SDN consolidated list. Names, aliases and record status require current official checks.

sources.name: UN Security Council · consolidated
sources.notes: Being on the UN list is not equivalent to an OFAC or EU designation. Regime-specific measures vary.

sources.name: United Kingdom · UK Sanctions List
sources.notes: Replaces the closed OFSI Consolidated List, retired 28 January 2026. Unique ID is the primary current key. Historic OFSI Group IDs are maintained as an explicit crosswalk, not proof of current designation without a UKSL match. Queries check both lists when archived access is available.

sources.name: UK HM Treasury / OFSI · archived consolidated list
sources.coverage: UK financial asset-freeze designations through 28 January 2026 (historical)
identifiers: UKSL historic OFSI Group ID crosswalk
sources.notes: Archived, no longer updated as of 28 January 2026. Historical entries absent from current UKSL are retained as historical only, never active. Historical CSV may be unavailable (official blob currently returns HTTP 409); the older OFSI search is reference-only. No name-only identity merges.

sources.name: European Commission · financial sanctions
sources.notes: EU acts published in the Official Journal control legal effect; check the latest acts, not just a cached consolidated extract.

sources.name: World Bank · debarred firms and individuals
sources.notes: Check active periods and grounds. Cross-debarment among participating banks is not automatic for every type of sanction.

sources.name: European Commission · EDES
sources.notes: EDES public entries are a subset of internal detection information.

sources.name: OpenSanctions · harmonized data
sources.notes: Free bulk download is noncommercial (CC BY-NC); commercial use requires license. Public-interest API keys are granted selectively. This aggregator is a lead, not source-of-record.

sources.name: UK Financial Conduct Authority · warning list
sources.notes: Warning is not criminal conviction or sanctions designation.

sources.name: EUROPOL / ENFAST · wanted persons
sources.notes: Arrest notices are not proof of guilt; avoid identity inference from names.

sources.name: UK Companies House · companies and PSC
sources.notes: API key required; PSC statements reflect reported control and may be incomplete or withheld for privacy.

sources.name: ICIJ · Offshore Leaks Database
sources.notes: Open database / share-alike attribution rules. Inclusion is not evidence of wrongdoing; historical records may be outdated.

sources.name: OCCRP · Aleph
sources.notes: Access and redistribution vary by dataset; source restrictions and provenance must survive graph exports.

sources.name: OpenCorporates · corporate index
sources.notes: Check current API tier, attribution and permitted use. Treat registry links as leads to primary records.

sources.name: EU e-Justice · interconnected business registries
sources.notes: Registry access and reuse rights differ by member state.

sources.name: GLEIF · Global LEI Index
sources.notes: LEI ownership relationships have reporting exceptions; no inferred beneficial ownership from absent LEIs.

sources.name: EITI · extractive ownership disclosures
sources.notes: Country-by-country reporting; no global register covering all concessions or ownership stakes.

sources.name: EU Tenders Electronic Daily · TED
sources.notes: Tender publication does not itself establish awarded performance or beneficial ownership.

sources.name: UN Comtrade · bilateral trade statistics
sources.notes: Aggregated customs statistics, not bills of lading, vessel itineraries or named consignee identities.

sources.name: World Bank · STEP procurement
sources.notes: Coverage limited to financed projects and available publication fields.

sources.name: OpenTender · public procurement
sources.notes: Check updated coverage and dataset-specific permissions; cross-check original national notice.

sources.name: USASpending.gov · federal awards
sources.notes: An award is not proof that political contributions caused a procurement decision.

sources.name: Open Contracting Partnership · OCDS
sources.notes: Data standard and discovery; not a universal government contract database.

sources.name: Panjiva · shipping trade intelligence
sources.notes: Paid commercial license. Do not scrape or imply unlicensed access.

sources.name: EUR-Lex · EU legal publications
sources.notes: Check consolidated vs legally authentic text and amendments.

sources.name: CanLII · Canadian decisions
sources.notes: Court reporting restrictions and republication rules apply; do not indiscriminately scrape personal data.

sources.name: BAILII · UK and Irish legal records
sources.notes: Legal decisions have distinct procedural posture and reporting restrictions.

sources.name: AustLII · Australian legal records
sources.notes: Respect bulk reuse restrictions and publication suppression orders.

sources.name: National official gazettes · jurisdiction registry
sources.notes: EU Official Journal is an initial primary example. Other national gazettes require per-country rights, layouts and validation.

sources.name: OpenSky Network · historical aviation data
sources.notes: Access limits and credential requirements apply. ICAO24 is an observed transponder address, not proof of legal ownership, pilot identity or intent.

sources.name: ADS-B Exchange · air-traffic observations
sources.notes: API subscription terms apply. No real-time tracking of identified private people exposed in this workbench.

sources.name: Equasis · shipping safety database
sources.notes: Registration and service terms restrict access; no unlicensed bulk harvesting.

sources.name: IMO · ship identification standards
sources.notes: IMO is a stable identifier for vessels but does not prove beneficial owner or cargo.

sources.name: UK Cabinet Office · Find a Tender (FTS)
sources.coverage: United Kingdom public procurement notices and awards
sources.notes: Public OCDS release API documented by UK Government. Link notices to supplier company registrations only on matching official identifiers. Supplier award status and performance are distinct. Endpoint registered; no live search connector wired yet.

sources.name: UK Companies House · PSC bulk records
sources.format: Bulk JSON snapshots (check release format and reuse terms)
sources.notes: Separate person with significant control from proven ultimate beneficial owner. Check reporting exemptions and historical changes. Public download indexed, not ingested.
sources.access: Public bulk subject to data terms

sources.name: UK official Gazette · company & insolvency notices
sources.coverage: UK Companies House, insolvency and legal notices
sources.format: HTML / published notices / structured feeds where permitted
sources.notes: Historical legal notice; does not itself establish current entity status. Source-specific access and privacy restrictions apply.

sources.name: Court of Justice of the EU · judgments (CURIA)
sources.coverage: European Union court judgments and orders
sources.notes: Distinguish applications, judgments, annulments and appellate posture, including sanctions litigation.

sources.name: UK Find a Tender — government procurement
sources.coverage: United Kingdom tender notices and contract awards
sources.notes: Official keyless public API. Date-filtered, first-page read-only intake (up to 30 releases). Not a complete procurement search; no misconduct or ownership conclusions.
sources.access: Open Government Licence v3.0, attribution required

sources.name: CanadaBuys — public procurement data
sources.format: Public notices and open government data CSV
sources.notes: Tender, award and contract records must be distinguished. Indexed for follow-up; not live-synced.

sources.name: New Zealand — GETS
sources.notes: Some detailed document access requires registration. No automated scraping of protected content.
